receipt: THE50 W5 T25: board-migration vocabulary drift across 10 boards

corpus.boards: the 10 source buckets exactly as harvest_meta.json filed them: 4chan_pol, 8chan_pol, 8chan_cbts, unknown(8), 8chan_thestorm, 8chan_greatawakening, 8chan_qresearch, 8chan_patriotsfight, 8kun_qresearch, 8kun_projectdcomms

what_landed: Per-board vocabulary census: drops, text-bearing drops, tokens, vocab size, span, top terms (10 boards, 105,628 tokens after cleaning, 283 empty-text rows counted but tokenless).

Migration order by first drop ts: 4chan_pol (2017-10-28) -> 8chan_pol -> 8chan_cbts -> unknown -> 8chan_thestorm -> 8chan_greatawakening -> 8chan_qresearch -> 8chan_patriotsfight -> 8kun_qresearch (2019-11-02) -> 8kun_projectdcomms.
Consecutive-board Jensen-Shannon drift curve, 9 steps, range 0.103 (8chan_pol->cbts) to 0.242 (thestorm->greatawakening, bits).

Top-20 shifting terms ranked by chi-square on 2x10 term-vs-rest tables, each with counts and per-1k rates on all 10 boards: bank, ceo, relevant, sa, central, tweets, hot, placeholder, republican, wonderland, therefore, trip, dec, conf, alice, connection, graphic, red, yes, government.

Migration signatures visible in the counts: 4chan-era register (bank 156/176 on 4chan_pol, sa, relevant, alice, wonderland, yes, conf) dies after the 2017 boards; cbts-era codes (ceo, red, dec) spike Dec 2017-Jan 2018; patriotsfight carries republican; projectdcomms (2020) re-imports placeholder and government.

computed_this_session.validation: artifact reloads as JSON, 10 boards, 20 term entries each with counts_by_board of length 10, 9-step JSD curve, em-dash count 0

honest_limits: Vocabulary comes from the text field only; 283 of 6,242 rows have empty text.
8chan_qresearch and 8kun_qresearch kept separate: the 2019 host move is part of the migration under test.

chi-square detects uneven distribution, not direction; peak/trough boards give direction, attributed only among boards with >= 20 text-bearing drops (unknown, 8 drops, excluded from labels, kept in counts).

First-pass top terms em/https/status were markup and URL artifacts (raw <em> tags, JSON-escaped slashes, space-broken twitter. com links in the qanon.pub dump); the cleaner was fixed and re-run rather than terms blacklisted; residual 'em' is genuine Elon-Musk shorthand usage verified in post context.
